example.zh: 他是这个领域的专家，有丰富的经验。
example.py: tā shì zhè gè lǐng yù de zhuān jiā ， yǒu fēng fù de jīng yàn 。
example.en: He is an expert in this field and has extensive experience.

example.zh: 上课时，他非常专心地听讲。
example.py: shàng kè shí ， tā fēi cháng zhuān xīn dì tīng jiǎng 。
example.en: During class, he listened very attentively.

example.zh: 他们逐步改进了工厂的生产流程。
example.py: tā mén zhú bù gǎi jìn liǎo gōng chǎng de shēng chǎn liú chéng 。
example.en: They gradually improved the factory's production processes.

example.zh: 他在网站上完成了新用户的注册。
example.py: tā zài wǎng zhàn shàng wán chéng liǎo xīn yòng hù de zhù cè 。
example.en: He completed the new user registration on the website.

example.zh: 他在会议上主持了这次讨论。
example.py: tā zài huì yì shàng zhǔ chí liǎo zhè cì tǎo lùn 。
example.en: He chaired the discussion at the meeting.

example.zh: 临行前，母亲拉着他的手再三嘱咐在异国他乡要保重身体。
example.py: Línxíng qián, mǔqīn lā zhe tā de shǒu zàisān zhǔfù zài yìguó tāxiāng yào bǎozhòng shēntǐ.
example.en: Prior to departure, his mother held his hand and repeatedly enjoined him to take good care of his health in a foreign land.

example.zh: 婚礼结束时,亲友们把最真诚的祝福送给了新人。
example.py: Hūnlǐ jiéshù shí, qīnyǒu men bǎ zuì zhēnchéng de zhùfú sòng gěi le xīnrén.
example.en: At the end of the wedding, relatives and friends gave their most sincere blessings to the newlyweds.

example.zh: 他对这件事的评价比较主观，缺乏客观性。
example.py: tā duì zhè jiàn shì de píng jià bǐ jiào zhǔ guān ， quē fá kè guān xìng 。
example.en: His assessment of this matter is rather subjective and lacks objectivity.

example.zh: 他非常追求完美，工作中不允许有任何失误。
example.py: tā fēi cháng zhuī qiú wán měi ， gōng zuò zhōng bù yǔn xǔ yǒu rèn hé shī wù 。
example.en: He is a perfectionist and does not tolerate any mistakes in his work.

example.zh: 他回到家，看到主人已经准备好了晚餐。
example.py: tā huí dào jiā ， kàn dào zhǔ rén yǐ jīng zhǔn bèi hǎo liǎo wǎn cān 。
example.en: He returned home to find that his host had already prepared dinner.

example.zh: 他代表公司主席出席了这次会议。
example.py: tā dài biǎo gōng sī zhǔ xí chū xí liǎo zhè cì huì yì 。
example.en: He attended the meeting on behalf of the company chairman.

example.zh: 他主张在制定政策前,先听取基层职员的意见。
example.py: Tā zhǔzhāng zài zhìdìng zhèngcè qián, xiān tīngqǔ jīcéng zhíyuán de yìjiàn.
example.en: He advocates listening to the opinions of front-line staff before making policy.

example.zh: 院子里有一片竹子，长得非常高。
example.py: yuàn zǐ lǐ yǒu yī piàn zhú zǐ ， cháng dé fēi cháng gāo 。
example.en: There is a grove of bamboo in the yard, which grows very tall.

example.zh: 他穿了一件紫色的衬衫参加晚会。
example.py: tā chuān liǎo yī jiàn zǐ sè de chèn shān cān jiā wǎn huì 。
example.en: He wore a purple shirt to the party.

example.zh: 自从他离开家乡，就再也没有回去过。
example.py: zì cóng tā lí kāi jiā xiāng ， jiù zài yě méi yǒu huí qù guò 。
example.en: He has never returned to his hometown since he left.

example.zh: 这辆车的天窗是自动打开的。
example.py: zhè liàng chē de tiān chuāng shì zì dòng dǎ kāi de 。
example.en: The sunroof on this car opens automatically.

example.zh: 他提交了入职申请，并附上了相关的资格证明。
example.py: tā tí jiāo liǎo rù zhí shēn qǐng ， bìng fù shàng liǎo xiāng guān de zī gé zhèng míng 。
example.en: He submitted his job application and attached relevant qualification certificates.

example.zh: 能代表学校参加全国比赛,他感到非常自豪。
example.py: Néng dàibiǎo xuéxiào cānjiā quánguó bǐsài, tā gǎndào fēicháng zìháo.
example.en: He felt very proud to be able to represent his school in a national competition.

example.zh: 公司为这个项目提供了充足的资金支持。
example.py: gōng sī wéi zhè gè xiàng mù tí gōng liǎo chōng zú de zī jīn zhī chí 。
example.en: The company provided ample financial support for this project.

meaning: to be aware, to act on one's own; conscious

example.zh: 他非常自觉，每天主动完成作业。
example.py: tā fēi cháng zì jué ， měi tiān zhǔ dòng wán chéng zuò yè 。
example.en: He is very self-disciplined and completes his homework on his own initiative every day.

example.zh: 请准备好相关资料。
example.py: qǐng zhǔn bèi hǎo xiāng guān zī liào 。
example.en: Please prepare the relevant documents.

example.zh: 这部纪录片提供中英文字幕,方便不同观众理解。
example.py: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn tígōng Zhōng-Yīngwén zìmù, fāngbiàn bùtóng guānzhòng lǐjiě.
example.en: This documentary provides Chinese and English subtitles, making it easier for different audiences to understand.

example.zh: 他保持着优雅的姿势站在台上。
example.py: tā bǎo chí zhuó yōu yǎ de zī shì zhàn zài tái shàng 。
example.en: He stood on the stage with an elegant posture.

example.zh: 她不关心别人；也就是说，她很自私。
example.py: tā bù guānxīn biéren ； yějiùshìshuō ， tā hěn zìsī 。
example.en: She does not care about other people; that is to say, she was very selfish.

meaning: to believe in oneself; self-confidence, confidence; confident

example.zh: 她非常自信地上台演讲。
example.py: tā fēi cháng zì xìn dì shàng tái yǎn jiǎng 。
example.en: She went on stage to give a speech with great confidence.

example.zh: 他通过热线电话咨询了医疗专家。
example.py: tā tōng guò rè xiàn diàn huà zī xún liǎo yī liáo zhuān jiā 。
example.en: He consulted a medical expert via a hotline.

example.zh: 每个人都渴望拥有自由的生活。
example.py: měi gè rén dū kě wàng yōng yǒu zì yóu de shēng huó 。
example.en: Everyone longs for a free life.

example.zh: 许多居民自愿参加社区的环保活动。
example.py: Xǔduō jūmín zìyuàn cānjiā shèqū de huánbǎo huódòng.
example.en: Many residents voluntarily took part in the community’s environmental activities.

example.zh: 这个国家有非常丰富的自然资源。
example.py: zhè gè guó jiā yǒu fēi cháng fēng fù de zì rán zī yuán 。
example.en: This country has very rich natural resources.

example.zh: 新任总裁上任后,立即宣布了数字化转型计划。
example.py: Xīnrèn zǒngcái shàngrèn hòu, lìjí xuānbù le shùzìhuà zhuǎnxíng jìhuà.
example.en: After taking office, the new CEO immediately announced a digital transformation plan.

example.zh: 参加这次活动的人总共有两百人。
example.py: cān jiā zhè cì huó dòng de rén zǒng gòng yǒu liǎng bǎi rén 。
example.en: A total of two hundred people participated in this event.

example.zh: 他综合了各方面的意见，做出了最终决定。
example.py: tā zōng hé liǎo gè fāng miàn de yì jiàn ， zuò chū liǎo zuì zhōng jué dìng 。
example.en: He took into account opinions from all sides and made the final decision.

example.zh: 宗教对他很重要。
example.py: zōng jiào duì tā hěn zhòng yào
example.en: Religion matters to him.

example.zh: 总理在记者会上回应了有关外交政策的提问。
example.py: Zǒnglǐ zài jìzhěhuì shàng huíyìng le yǒuguān wàijiāo zhèngcè de tíwèn.
example.en: The prime minister responded to questions about foreign policy at the press conference.

example.zh: 经过再三验证,工程总算达到了预期标准。
example.py: Jīngguò zàisān yànzhèng, gōngchéng zǒngsuàn dádào le yùqī biāozhǔn.
example.en: After repeated verification, the project finally reached the expected standard.

example.zh: 美国总统出席了这次国际峰会。
example.py: měi guó zǒng tǒng chū xí liǎo zhè cì guó jì fēng huì 。
example.en: The US president attended this international summit.

example.zh: 总之，这次经历让他学到了很多。
example.py: zǒng zhī ， zhè cì jīng lì ràng tā xué dào liǎo hěn duō 。
example.en: In short, he learned a lot from this experience.

example.zh: 无论走到哪里,他都始终关注祖国的发展。
example.py: Wúlùn zǒu dào nǎlǐ, tā dōu shǐzhōng guānzhù zǔguó de fāzhǎn.
example.en: No matter where he goes, he always pays attention to the development of his motherland.

example.zh: 这幅画是由多种颜色组合在一起完成的。
example.py: zhè fú huà shì yóu duō zhǒng yán sè zǔ hé zài yī qǐ wán chéng de 。
example.en: This painting is created by combining multiple colors.

example.zh: 他喝多了，有点醉了，走路不稳。
example.py: tā hē duō liǎo ， yǒu diǎn zuì liǎo ， zǒu lù bù wěn 。
example.en: He had drunk too much and was a little drunk; he was unsteady on his feet.

example.zh: 他在这家公司的最初工作非常出色。
example.py: tā zài zhè jiā gōng sī de zuì chū gōng zuò fēi cháng chū sè 。
example.en: He performed exceptionally well in his initial work at the company.

example.zh: 刑警经过数月排查与技术追踪，终于在边境地区将潜逃多年的罪犯抓获。
example.py: Xíngjǐng jīngguò shù yuè páichá yǔ jìshù zhuīzōng, zhōngyú zài biānjìng dìqū jiāng qiántáo duō nián de zuìfàn zhuāhuò.
example.en: After months of investigation and technical tracking, criminal detectives finally apprehended the criminal who had been on the run for years in the border region.

example.zh: 他尊敬每一位前辈，虚心向他们学习。
example.py: tā zūn jìng měi yī wèi qián bèi ， xū xīn xiàng tā mén xué xí 。
example.en: He respects every senior and humbly learns from them.

example.zh: 他严格遵守了公司的各项规章制度。
example.py: tā yán gé zūn shǒu liǎo gōng sī de gè xiàng guī zhāng zhì dù 。
example.en: He strictly abided by all the company's rules and regulations.

example.zh: 这位画家的作品非常有名。
example.py: zhè wèi huà jiā de zuò pǐn fēi cháng yǒu míng 。
example.en: This painter's works are very famous.

meaning: to act as, to serve as; as, being

example.zh: 作为学生，要认真学习。
example.py: zuò wéi xué shēng ， yào rèn zhēn xué xí 。
example.en: As students, we must study diligently.

example.zh: 老师布置了一篇作文。
example.py: lǎo shī bù zhì liǎo yī piān zuò wén 。
example.en: The teacher assigned an essay.

example.zh: 许多传统节日都与纪念祖先有关。
example.py: Xǔduō chuántǒng jiérì dōu yǔ jìniàn zǔxiān yǒuguān.
example.en: Many traditional festivals are connected with honouring ancestors.

example.zh: 警察及时阻止了这场打架事件。
example.py: jǐng chá jí shí zǔ zhǐ liǎo zhè cháng dǎ jià shì jiàn 。
example.en: The police stopped the fight in time.
